GitHub Copilot PanelInteractive demo · Synthetic data · No sign-in

About this demo

A standalone browser port of the GitHub Copilot Panel Power BI template: the same seven pages, layout and calculations, running entirely in your browser. There is no Power BI service, sign-in or network request.

  • All data is synthetic. 200 invented people, 26 weekly periods. No real person, organisation or telemetry is represented.
  • Measures are a JavaScript port of the template's DAX. Group By, slicers and the date range work as in the report; clicking a bar or table row cross-filters the page.
  • Value page: money figures (capacity, value, investment, ROI) are assumption-based what-ifs driven by the Assumptions panel — a demo-only control. Measured figures are labelled as such.
  • The Language option of Group By is omitted: it has no effect on person-level measures.
  • Source, base revision and licence (MIT) are in provenance.json.

Assumptions (demo only)

Edit the template's config values and every figure follows. Synthetic what-ifs, not findings.
